_comment: P05-01 — DETERMINISTIC LOCAL MARKET-DATA FEED FIXTURES.
These are PROVIDER-NATIVE shaped payloads for the single local synthetic source 'localfix'.
They deliberately use provider-native field names so that the adapter mapping boundary is
B-1  the adapter is the ONLY place provider-native schemas/symbols/units may exist
A-19 no provider-native field name, symbol, error code or enum may CROSS the boundary
A-14 map provider-native -> canonical per P02_PROVIDER_MAPPING_RULES
SYNTHETIC DATA. No live provider, no network, no credential, no entitlement.
DETERMINISTIC: every value is a fixed literal. Decimals are carried as STRINGS so that
NP-2 exact decimal semantics hold without binary floating-point fidelity loss.

quotes._note: price.last/.bid/.ask are pitEligible=false (LIVE intraday) per P01_FIELD_DICTIONARY §3.
NEGATIVE-DATA FIXTURE: bid/ask absent. Silence is NOT_PROVIDED, never zero (NL-4, NL-7, A-20).

closes._note: price.close/.previousClose/.volume/.vwap are pitEligible=true; effectiveTime is the session boundary.
DV-3 fixture: a NEW dataVersion at a DIFFERENT asOf — a distinct snapshot, not an edit.

valuations._note: COLLISION-CRITICAL (D4_07 §I.1): these correspond to existing free-form engine keys shared across 2-6 engines. They are namespaced MD:valuation.* and may only reach an engine through an explicit declared mapping (P11) — never by name coincidence.

ohlcv._note: AJ-1: adjusted and unadjusted are BOTH retained. AJ-3: adjusted=true without adjustmentBasisRef is invalid — so adj=false here carries no basis ref.

malformed._note: E5 MALFORMED_RESPONSE: violates the declared provider schema. Rejection, never quality.
SM-2: currency is not ISO-4217 -> CONTRACT_MAPPING_FAILURE. Rejected, not defaulted (CU-2).
NP-3: value carries 4 decimals against declared precision 2. Silent rounding is prohibited.

FC-1: an unmapped canonical identity must FAIL EXPLICITLY - no coercion, no placeholder, no synthesised companyId, no null join key (ADP-2). FC-6: E1-E8 is UNCHANGED, so at the provider boundary this surfaces as the EXISTING class E8 carrying violatedRules FC-1/ADP-2/MC-7 - and it is explicitly NOT E1 and NOT a quality state (FC-5).
TS-1: local-time-only / non-ISO-8601-UTC timestamp is invalid.

unsupportedRequests._note: CL-4: E6 is evaluated PRE-FLIGHT, before any provider call. The local feed declares D01/D02/D10 only.

This feed declares LIVE|SNAPSHOT only (PIT storage is P08, NOT_STARTED), so a PIT request fails PRE-FLIGHT as E6 (CL-4) before any acquisition. The SM-7 / FD-6 / MD-4 rejection for a PIT snapshot carrying a non-PIT-eligible field is proven separately at the validation layer in tests/validation.test.js.

providerUnavailable._note: E1 is the ONLY quality-bearing class (P02 §1.2): produces a snapshot with EMPTY fields and quality='unavailable'. ST-9 permits empty fields only here.
